items.name: qti-pie
items.title: qti-pie
items.description: plate's React layer styled for shadcn: Item, Status, Navigation, Choice, Text Entry, Extended Text and Inline Choice wrapped with Tailwind classes on shadcn's theme tokens, and plate's stylesheet.
items.docs: Import styles/qti-pie.css once, from your app's global stylesheet or entry file; it brings in @qti-pie/plate/styles.css and sets no theme token, so your shadcn theme styles plate's parts. Then use QtiItem, QtiStatus, QtiNavigation, QtiChoice, QtiTextEntry, QtiExtendedText and QtiInlineChoice from the installed qti-pie component in place of the components of the same name in @qti-pie/plate/react. @qti-pie/plate is not published to npm yet, so this item installs into an app that already has it, as a workspace package or a tarball.
